_doc: Manual review of the automatic ceiling-light detection on the LiDAR intensity map (2026-10-08, zoom_*.png). Points are approximate; 08 refines position/size on the intensity map (+-0.12 m, standard sizes). 'remove' drops detections within r of the point; 'add' inserts a panel to be refined; 'to_hvac' converts a detection to a ceiling cassette.

row_consistency.note: panels in one row share the row's majority size

alignment._doc: user 2026-10-08: lights must sit in straight rows/columns. Rows (same y) and columns (same x) are formed from panels (same orientation) and downlights whose centres differ by < tol_m, are < max_gap_m apart along the line and see each other without a wall / glass line in between; each line snaps to the median of its panels (else of its downlights). Lights farther than tol_m from that value stay as measured. Downlight blobs closer than min_wall_dist_m to a wall / glass line are dropped (wall-top artefacts). Corridor lines: every downlight inside 'box' is put on the centre line c and re-spaced evenly at the measured pitch within runs (gap > split_gap_m starts a new run). Measured positions are kept as x_meas / y_meas.
